title: Baseline evidence and compatibility harness
goal: Capture the 0.7.0 behavior, formats and populated data as executable evidence and install the boundary, parity and distribution checks every later phase is measured against, without changing production behavior.
context: Architecture phase A (revision 2, D12). Approximate size: M. Replaces revision 1's schema-first phase: persistence ownership is fixed in knowledge/architecture#persistence and executed in P3 together with its owner. Only tests, fixtures and CI change here. Task decomposition is deferred to a separate session.

consumes: The 0.7.0 code, migrations, manifests, CI and existing suites
produces: Populated 0.7.0 database fixtures per driver: default storage, named storage, published core migrations, schema-1 database

Frozen snapshots: DDL/constraints, event and audit payloads, config keys, CLI names/options/exit codes, publish tags, doctor/explain JSON, exception codes, serializable-FQCN inventory, 0.7.0 API manifest
Parity harness for scalar/batch/SQL/directory/write over existing fixtures, including no scope declaration and two panels
Boundary scans (I2, I3, I5) and the inactive-cost harness (I13) in report mode with owned, shrinking allowlists
boundaries: No production code or behavior change
Every new check states which invariant it proves and whether it blocks now or after a named phase
Allowlist entries name the phase that removes them

include: tests/Fixtures and Engines fixtures for populated 0.7.0 databases
Parity harness reusing existing property suites
tests workflow consumer job and bin/consumer-fixture.sh
release.yml validate job: consumer-fixture runs for core and core+Filament (owner amendment, D14)
tests/Arch/Fixtures/target-map.json: byte copy of artifacts/inventory/target-map.json with recorded sha256 as the scan oracle (D14)
exclude: StorageSchema, migration, installer or doctor behavior changes

pitfalls: A snapshot taken after any P2 change is not a 0.7.0 baseline
hasTable alone does not describe the audit table shape that P3 must adopt
Published migration copies and package-loaded migrations share basenames; both variants need fixtures
A parity harness that skips unsupported mappings must record them as unsupported, not as agreement
Check whether 0.7.0 applications could already use an azg_ grant field name
Folder discovery collects Scopes/ classes today; record what consumes them before P2 changes the declaration slot

validation.procedure: Run the full existing matrix plus the new fixtures, snapshots, parity harness, boundary scans and blocking consumer job on the unchanged 0.7.0 code on every supported driver.
validation.expect: All existing suites stay green; every new check passes against 0.7.0 or reports only allowlisted findings with an owner phase; the consumer job blocks on failure.

deliverables: Boundary and inactive-cost scans with allowlists
Inventory of serializable FQCNs and exception codes

sections.title: Mandatory design inputs
sections.text:
The detailing session for P1 reads these before authoring any item (`show` of this phase is the entry point; the list is mandatory):

```bash
P='python3 <task>/scripts/plan.py'; ID=2026.10.10-№1-AZGUARD-CORE-STABILIZATION
$P get $ID knowledge/architecture --section product
$P get $ID knowledge/architecture --section ownership
$P get $ID knowledge/architecture --section persistence
$P get $ID knowledge/architecture --section operation-chains
$P get $ID knowledge/architecture --section invariants
$P get $ID knowledge/architecture --section release-gate
$P get $ID knowledge/architecture --section transition-policy
$P get $ID knowledge/identities            # all sections
$P get $ID knowledge/type-map            # rules (the oracle itself is artifacts/inventory/target-map.json)
$P get $ID D11
$P get $ID D12
$P get $ID D13
```

Rules for the detailed items:

- Each item lists in `reads` (with `section`, `required: true`) the reference sections it implements; a phase-bound document that no item reads is reported by `design-done` (`phase_documents_unread`) and must be resolved before the phase counts as detailed.
- Items cite their type-map rows by current FQCN in `scope.include`; an item may not move, rename or re-mark a type differently from `knowledge/type-map`.
- If `design-done` reports a pack over the 256 KB budget, move the binding of a reference document from the phase to the items that read it (`plan.py unlink … --kind applies_to`, `plan.py link …`) — never drop the read.
- Boundary scans (I2, I3, I5) must read `artifacts/inventory/target-map.json` as the ownership oracle instead of a hand-written namespace list; identity snapshots cover every row of `knowledge/identities`.

sections.title: Exit criterion
sections.text: Every invariant I1–I22 in knowledge/architecture#invariants has an executable check or a recorded owner phase; 0.7.0 behavior, formats and populated data are reproducible from fixtures; nothing in production changed.
